name: Fine-tune Dataset Validator
blurb: a chat-format JSONL training set checked for format errors, duplicates, length and balance
intro: Checks every JSONL line against the chat fine-tuning formats (OpenAI messages, Anthropic-style system + messages, prompt/completion): JSON, roles and turn order, a final assistant answer, empty content, tool-call format; then the set as a whole: exact and near duplicates (MinHash over word 3-grams), contradicting answers, system prompt drift, train/validation overlap, estimated token lengths and label balance. Writes the cleaned JSONL.

inputs.label: Training JSONL
inputs.help: One example per line. You can also drop a .jsonl file on the page.

inputs.label: Validation JSONL (optional)
inputs.help: Checked the same way and for overlap with training.

inputs.label: Label for balance
inputs.help: Empty = no balance check. assistant = the answer text; assistant:json.key = a key of a JSON answer; a.b.c = a field of the record.

inputs.label: Max tokens per example
inputs.help: Your budget or the model's training context (check the provider's limit).

inputs.label: Near-duplicate similarity
inputs.help: Jaccard similarity of word 3-grams, 0-1. 0.7 is about one word changed in a 20-word example.

inputs.label: Drop validation lines found in training

examples.title: Ticket triage set (OpenAI chat): bad JSON, a missing answer, a duplicate, a near duplicate, a contradiction, a tool-call format error, an over-long log, unbalanced labels

usage: Give train (JSONL text), optionally valid (JSONL), format (auto, openai-chat, anthropic, prompt-completion), labelField (assistant, assistant:json.key or a dotted record path; empty = none), maxTokens, nearThreshold (0-1) and the drop* switches. Returns counts (rejected lines, duplicates, near duplicates, over-length, validation overlap), an issues-by-kind table with line numbers, a per-line issue list, label balance, a text report and the cleaned training and validation JSONL. Use it before uploading a fine-tuning file; token counts are estimates and provider limits are dated.
